answer: Admit new identities slowly per origin: at most a handful per network origin per epoch, like terraces that let water through one level at a time. A datacenter trying to plant a garden of fakes hits the cap immediately, while honest users from diverse origins pass through unnoticed. The admission ledger publishes a signal, per-origin counts each epoch, so any burst is visible to all, and the cap turns a flood into a trickle the network can absorb.
